about:
**GlobalPlayed Addon** [![curseforge-badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/curseforge-grey?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=%23f16436&logoSize=auto&labelColor=%231a1a1a&color=%231a1a1a)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/globalplayed) [![wagoio-badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/wago.io-blue.svg?logoSize=auto&labelColor=%231a1a1a&color=%231a1a1a&style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)](https://addons.wago.io/addons/globalplayed)
==
Small addon to get your total playtime across characters, on Retail and WoW Forever. Played time is fetched silently at each character login.

**Takes advantage of the LibDataBroker-1.1 library to be ready to use with [**TitanPanel**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/titan-panel), [**Arcana** (Formerly ChocolateBar)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/arcana), and so many others !**

### **Usage**
* Connect once to each of your characters: WoW only gives the played time of the character you are logged on
* Type any GlobalPlayed command in chat, use the minimap button or the data broker in your display addon
* Retail and WoW Forever keep separate totals

### **Available in-game commands**
* **/gplayed** : Refresh and show the window (or your account total in chat if the window is disabled in options)
* **/gplayed all** : Refresh and show the window (or every character and the account total in chat if the window is disabled in options)
* **/gplayed options** : Open the GlobalPlayed options panel (also via **Esc > Options > Add-ons > GlobalPlayed**)
* A key binding to show or hide played time is available in **Esc > Options > Keybindings > AddOns**

### **Minimap button, addon compartment and data broker**
* **Hover** : characters with their played time, and the account total
* **Left click** : open/close the window, or print the report in chat if the window is disabled
* **Middle click** : refresh the played time
* **Right click** : open the options panel

### **Window**
* Characters grouped by realm, class or faction, sorted by name or played time
* Columns adapt to the window width, and its size and position are remembered
* **Refresh** button next to **Close**

### **Options** (**Esc > Options > Add-ons > GlobalPlayed**)
* Use the window, or print reports in chat
* Class colors, short duration units, full played time with minutes and seconds, faction icons
* Show or hide the minimap button and the addon compartment entry
* Text of the data broker: addon name, account total or current character
* Group and sort characters
* Remove the characters you deleted from the list (the logged in character cannot be removed)
* Import played time from DataStore or Altoholic when they are installed

### **Dependencies**
* [Embedded] [**CallbackHandler-1.0**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/callbackhandler)
* [Embedded] [**LibDataBroker-1.1**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libdatabroker-1-1)
* [Embedded] [**LibDBIcon-1.0**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libdbicon-1-0)
* [Embedded] [**LibStub**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/libstub)

### **Translations**
All the texts of GlobalPlayed are listed in `Locales/enUS.lua`, the reference for translators. Pull requests for new languages are welcome! To add one:

1. Copy `Locales/enUS.lua` to a new file named after the game language: `deDE`, `esES`, `esMX`, `itIT`, `koKR`, `ptBR`, `ruRU`, `zhCN` or `zhTW`.
2. Replace the line `GlobalPlayed_Locale_RegisterDefault({` with `GlobalPlayed_Locale_Register("deDE", {`, using your language code.
3. Translate only the right side of each line. The left side must stay in English, exactly as it is. Keep `%s` and `%d` in your text: the addon replaces them with values.
4. In `GlobalPlayed.toc`, add your file right after `Locales/frFR.lua`.
5. Optionally, in `GlobalPlayed.toc`, add the addon list texts: `## Notes-deDE:` and `## Category-deDE:`, using the [official category names](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Addon_Categories).
6. Check it on a game client in your language, then open a pull request against `master`.

A translation can be partial: any missing text is displayed in English. When a new text is added to the code, add it to `Locales/enUS.lua` too.

### **Bug reports & Feature requests**
Bug reports and feature requests are welcome. Feel free to create issues on the [GitHub project](https://github.com/RedSkiesReaperr/GlobalPlayed/) to submit them!

## Dev Helps & Docs

- [warcraft.wiki.gg API](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft_API)
- [Lua 5.1 manual](https://www.lua.org/manual/5.1/) (the Lua version used by WoW)
- [wow-ui-source](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source)

### Releasing
Push a `vX.Y.Z` tag, or `vX.Y.Z-betaN` for a beta. It must match `## Version:` in `GlobalPlayed.toc` and a dated `## X.Y.Z (YYYY-MM-DD)` entry in `CHANGELOG.md`. The workflow then packages the addon and uploads it to CurseForge, Wago and GitHub Releases. Tags must be annotated (`git tag -a`).

# Changelogs

## 1.7.0 (2026-11-09)

- Add native window, used by default and can be disabled in the options, Ace3 is no longer needed
- Add minimap button and addon compartment entry, both can be disabled in the options
- Add addon icon in the addon list
- Add key binding to show or hide played time
- Add played time import from DataStore and Altoholic, from a button in the options
- Add choice of the text shown by the data broker: addon name, account total or current character
- Add characters can be grouped by realm, class or faction
- Add characters can be sorted by name or played time
- Add French translation
- Add tooltips explaining each option
- Add options grouped in sections, with a separate page for characters
- Add auto upload to GitHub Releases
- Remove Save & Reload button, every option now applies immediately
- Fix open window now updates as soon as played time is received
- Fix repeated commands while played time is being requested

## 1.6.0 (2026-11-07)

- Add WoW Forever support
- Update Interface version for Retail v12.1.5 and Forever v1.60.1
- Add played time is now fetched silently at character login
- Add **/gplayed** and **/gplayed all** now refresh played time before displaying it
- Add MiddleClick on databroker object no longer prints in chat
- Add option to display minutes and seconds in played time
- Add characters can now be removed from the options panel
- Add characters and realms are now sorted by name in every list
- Add GlobalPlayed window now adapts its columns to its width and remembers its size and position
- Add Refresh button in the GlobalPlayed window
- Add auto build and upload to CurseForge and Wago.io
- Fix account and realm totals losing the minutes of each character
- Fix faction and class are now refreshed at each character login
- Fix databroker clicks ignored on Titan Panel
- Fix options panel checkboxes on current game versions
- Fix install in Interface/AddOns/ without GlobalPlayed/
- Fix addon files loaded twice
- Fix display error for characters with an unknown class
- Fix class colors now match the official game colors
- Fix options added by new versions now get their default value on upgrade
- Fix account total hours now use two digits like characters
- Fix /gplayed commands now ignore case and extra spaces
- Fix WoW Forever characters now use their full name, so characters sharing a first name are no longer merged
- Fix WoW Forever characters are now grouped under a single header instead of a technical realm name

## What's Changed
* 11.0.7 support by @RedSkiesReaperr in https://github.com/RedSkiesReaperr/GlobalPlayed/pull/2

## New Contributors
* @RedSkiesReaperr made their first contribution in https://github.com/RedSkiesReaperr/GlobalPlayed/pull/2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/RedSkiesReaperr/GlobalPlayed/compare/1.5.2...1.5.3
